title: Redstone Geysers
description: A redstone controlled sulfur geyser block that erupts only while powered.
body:
Redstone Geyser adds a controllable version of the vanilla Potent Sulfur geyser.

Unlike the normal block, this geyser only erupts when powered by redstone!!!

- Redstone-controlled eruptions
- Instant activate/deactivate behavior
- Powered and unpowered textures
- Vanilla geyser visuals and effects
- Craftable survival recipe
- Compatible with redstone contraptions

Power it to erupt
Remove power to shut it down
